# uzc_port_forwarding_rule (Resource)

Manages a port forwarding rule on a UzCloud IP address. There is no update endpoint, so changing any attribute recreates the rule. The resource ID is "{ip_address}/{rule_id}".

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_port_forwarding_rule" "example" {
  ip_address         = uzc_ip_address.example.slug
  protocol           = "tcp"
  private_start_port = 8080
  private_end_port   = 8080
  public_start_port  = 80
  public_end_port    = 80
  virtual_machine    = uzc_virtual_machine.example.slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_address` (String) Slug of the uzc_ip_address to attach the rule to.
- `private_end_port` (Number)
- `private_start_port` (Number)
- `protocol` (String) One of "tcp" or "udp".
- `public_end_port` (Number)
- `public_start_port` (Number)
- `virtual_machine` (String) Slug of the virtual machine to forward traffic to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) "{ip_address}/{rule_id}". Used for import.
- `rule_id` (String) Server-assigned rule id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_port_forwarding_rule.example <ip-address-slug>/<rule-id>
```
